title: Ethics Commission orders and assessed penalties
question: Which decisions did San Francisco’s Ethics Commission enter, and what amount did its register record?
finding: The City lists 165 decisions. The archive review matched 1,260 enforcement-related passages to their records or other dispositions, including 87 distinct Ethics proceedings.
how: Each row links to the supporting document published by the Commission. Amounts are as reported in its enforcement dataset. Several settlements combine administrative penalties with late-filing fees.
limits: The register reports the resolution date and terms. Receipt of funds requires separate proof. A reporting violation alone establishes neither a bribe nor a loss to taxpayers.
